headline: FDE-Gym benchmarks AI agents on end-to-end customer delivery
summary: FDE-Gym introduces 95 end-to-end AI delivery tasks adapted from 20 customer scenarios across 18 sectors. Across 13 model configurations, the authors report Claude Opus 5.5’s best mean L3 score as 0.56 (95% task-bootstrap interval 0.50–0.62) and 14 resolved tasks out of 95, using customer-metric uplift adjusted for operational incidents and stakeholder contact costs. These are paper-reported results from simulated stakeholders and production-like workspaces; a human baseline is still being collected, and the scores have not been independently reproduced.
